newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-Matthews takes 500th wicket as NSW cruise.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Matthews takes 500th wicket as NSW cruise.

text.p: Former Australia all-rounder Greg Matthews took his 500th first-class wicket on Sunday as New South Wales took a firm grip on their Sheffield Shield match against South Australia.
New South Wales built a substantial lead after adding a rapidly-scored second innings of 173 for three to their first innings of 415.

South Australia, bowled out for a paltry 137 in the first innings, suffered another unwanted batting collapse to be 174 for six at stumps on the third day, still 277 runs behind New South Wales going into Monday's final day.
Matthews, who played 33 tests for Australia, snared his 500th first-class wicket when he had South Australian opener Jeff Vaughan caught at short mid-on by David Freedman for six.

Vaughan's dismissal was soon followed by that of Geoff Parker for two for South Australia to be 47 for two. Opener Martin Faull and middle-order batsman Darren Lehmann fought back with a partnership of 92.
Faull made 68 and Lehmann was unbeaten on 62.
South Australia's fightback proved to be a brief one as the home side lost their next four wickets for 25. Pace bowler Phil Alley claimed all four wickets in a devastating spell.
Opener Rodney Davison and all-rounder Shane Lee earlier earlier helped New South Wales extend their lead with a partnership of 126.
